a.lede: Store-bought Ledger hardware crypto wallets in Southeast Asia and Europe compromised in ongoing supply chain attack — $71 million and counting thanks to implanted eSIM and LTE modules
a.title: Store-bought hardware crypto wallets had secret chips installed that enabled stealing crypto recovery phrases

b.lede: Ledger is reviewing chain-of-custody practices and anti-tamper protections after modified hardware wallets sold through a third party were allegedly fitted with LTE implants that captured recovery phrases and enabled $93 million in crypto theft.
b.title: After a $93 million crypto hardware-wallet supply chain attack, Ledger to review sales and anti-tamper policies
